revision.text: I Am occultist, not really dedicated to Cicada stuff, but I think you guys missed few important things (or I missed you mentioning them). First, Cicada is clearly connected to occult/magical/mystical traditions, what was proved many times through names like Agrippa, books like Crowley's Liber AL, Gematria, magic squares, runes, some other things I forgot in the process of writing this sentence, and the enlightenment itself. Based on that, I belive, you need to pay more attention into the occult, including both ancient and new age myths (like Thelema). And so, few clues from me: - There is a legend of a man called Odin, who hanged himself on the Tree and got enlightened and received the runes. - According to my knowledge, the word "Gematria" primarily referred to the method that ancient "Kabbalists" (e.g. but >not only Jewish< Mystics) used. - There is a magical/mystical system of Kabbalah based on a "Tree of Life" which is composed of "sephiroth" ("numbers"). - There exists a book called "Sepher Sephiroth" ("The book of numbers" or Liber 500), whose author was the one, who received Liber AL (mentioned above). It lists i.a. large amount of gematric values and apprioprate hebrew words appearing in the Bible (e.g. the "Rashith ha-Gilgalim or "Sphere of Primum Mobile" has the value of 1032). (Another usefull book might be also the Liber 777). But beware, there are many mistakes (some of them intentional, I think), so it's better to at least learn hebrew alphabeth and check every word and value yourself.

revision.text: Hello all,    I feel that the comunity has lost sight of some important clues.  If we look at this logically, this is still the same puzzle from 2014.  The Liber Primus is still the key to this whole thing, which stands to reason that the puzzle should be solvable using only what we know from 2014.  Everything that can be attributed to Cicada 3301 since then should be able to augment and assist, but should not be 100% manditory for the solving.  We should be taking a harder look at what we already have, like the pages that have been deciphered.  Those pages were encrypted with nothing more than a simple mono-alphabetic cipher, and the last two whe not encrypted at all.  In my opinion, Cicada has never published anything that has been irrelevant.  so these pages must be at least somewhat connected, must contain somthing that can help us.  In these already decoded pages, there are two prime Magic Squares adding to 3301 1033 with the title Know This, there is also a passage that states "Along the way you will find an end to all struggle and suffering" and "Ultimately youu will discover an end to self" these passages both refer to finding "an end" which if you recall is the red text title from the second last page where we find  "36367763ab73783c7af284446c  59466b4cd653239a311cb7116 d4618dee09a8425893dc7500b 464fdaf1672d7bef5e891c6e227 4568926a49fb4f45132c2a8b4" which is supposedly a hash of a website which we are supposed to seek out.  This is where I feel our efforts need to be focused. -Cromwell
